type.zh: 八通道电子保险与配电保护模块
type.en: Eight-channel electronic fuse and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-B-8CL2-B1是PULS公开目录中的八通道电子保险与配电保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA-B-8CL2-B1 is a eight-channel electronic fuse and distribution protection in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: NEC Class2版本按输入电压自适应限制输出；CH1–2与CH3–8的限流方式及容性负载能力不同。B1为报警继电器，B4为数字编码状态接口。
overview.en: The NEC Class2 version adapts output limits to supply voltage. CH1–2 and CH3–8 differ in limiting and capacitive-load behavior. B1 uses an alarm relay;B4 a digitally coded status interface.

overview.zh: PISA-B-812-B4是PULS公开目录中的八通道电子保险与配电保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。

overview.zh: 可独立设定各路电流并选择共同快/慢跳闸模式；各路上限、40A总电流及温度降额须同时满足。B1/B4状态接口不同。

overview.zh: PISA11.401是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.401 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.402是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.402 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.403是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.403 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.404是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.404 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.406是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.406 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.410是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.410 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.203206是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.203206 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.206212是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.206212 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.

overview.zh: PISA11.CLASS2是PULS公开目录中的四通道共同保护模块，用于工业控制柜和机器人外围设备的直流供电分支。它不是机器人安全控制器，也不是电池充电器。
overview.en: PISA11.CLASS2 is a four-channel common protection module in the PULS public catalog, relevant to DC branches in industrial cabinets and robot auxiliary equipment. It is neither a robot safety controller nor a battery charger.

overview.zh: 任一路过载、合计过流或输入欠压保护可能共同关闭四路输出；不能按八通道系列的选择性独立跳闸方式理解。容性负载表分别给出全部输出带载与仅一路带载的条件。
overview.en: An overloaded channel, combined overcurrent or input safeguarding can shut all four outputs together; do not assume the eight-channel series selective behavior. Capacitive-load tables distinguish all-loaded and one-loaded tests.
